description: User aircraft draft. No measured hardware parameters yet. No inheritance from upstream_reference.json.

mass.source: Weigh the complete flight configuration, including battery, sensors and wiring.

gravity.source: Initial local-gravity convention for offline research; not a measurement.

tvc_arm.source: Locate CoM and effective TVC pivot; current model requires pivot at [0,0,+arm] in FRD.

inertia_xx.source: Obtain inertia about CoM from mass-checked CAD or an identification experiment.

inertia_yy.source: Obtain inertia about CoM; do not assume equality with Ixx without checking.

inertia_zz.source: Obtain inertia about CoM; do not copy Ixx or Iyy.

yaw_accel_per_legacy_mass_equivalent.source: Legacy-reference field only. Not needed by the new aircraft roll study; do not copy the upstream yaw fit.

yaw_torque_per_differential_thrust.source: Identify signed reaction torque per differential thrust, with explicit motor numbering and spin directions.

max_total_thrust.source: Measure the complete coaxial assembly at minimum operating voltage using a protected remotely stopped test stand.

tvc_angle_limit.source: Check collision-free actual gimbal output travel, not servo shaft travel; begin with propellers removed.

servo_rate_limit.source: Identify actual gimbal output rate under representative load; document voltage and linkage.

servo_design_time_constant.source: Select from an identified actuator response, or label an explicit simulation hypothesis as assumed.

lqi_sample_period.source: Select the future control period after architecture and timing review; legacy LQI remains reference-only.

actuator_study_sample_period.source: Choose an explicit offline experiment sample period; this does not configure a flight scheduler.
